subject.title: fix(feishu): retry transient message send failures

question: Should Feishu message create and reply operations adopt up to two transient retries when every attempt reuses one UUID?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the change, but accepting retry behavior on a message-delivery boundary is an owner-level reliability tradeoff that tests cannot fully settle.

options.title: Approve bounded UUID retries
options.body: Accept the documented transient classifier and stable UUID reuse after refreshing the branch and rerunning focused Feishu proof.

options.title: Narrow retry classification
options.body: Limit retries to a smaller owner-approved set of transport codes and HTTP statuses before merge.

options.title: Keep single-attempt delivery
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want automatic replay on Feishu create/reply calls.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded UUID retries
recommendation.body: Accept the documented transient classifier and stable UUID reuse after refreshing the branch and rerunning focused Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work touched the streaming message-send boundary affected by this retry policy.
